text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Romania had to fulfil nine criteria, including privatisation or closure of 10 loss-making companies and privatisation of 2,750 other firms, in order to get the second IMF tranche, the paper says.
- The State Ownership Fund will pay fines worth $13.9 million for the release of Romanian ships detained in ports across the world.
- Floods affected scores of households and disrupted rail and road traffic in the Prahova county.
- The SNCFR railway authority raised passenger tariffs with 15 percent and with 6.7 percent for freight transport.
- Rivers in southern Romania have reached flooding levels, the paper says.
- The Petromidia refinery cut with 100,000 lei per tonne the prices for diesel oil and premium petrol.
- The IMF is unhappy over the slow pace of Romania's economic reforms, the paper says.
